build_teams_management_client: build a TeamsManagementClient to connect to a LiteLLM proxy server with an optional API key for authentication
create_list_teams: create a list of teams the user belongs to filtered by user_id or organization_id
create_list_teams_v2: create a paginated list of teams with filtering by team_id, team_alias, and sorting options
test_list_teams: test the TeamsManagementClient.list method to retrieve teams for a given user_id
review_get_available_teams: review the TeamsManagementClient.get_available method to fetch teams a user can join
